reports.title: Omnicell Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Guidance
section: The table below summarizes Omnicell’s fourth quarter and updated full year 2026 guidance. Given our strong third quarter 2026 profitability performance and continued focus on disciplined execution, we are increasing our full year 2026 non-GAAP EBITDA and non-GAAP earnings per share guidance ranges. In addition, as we are through the first three quarters of the year, we are tightening our full year 2026 total, product, and service revenues guidance ranges. We are also tightening our full year 2026 annual recurring revenue guidance range, with the low end unchanged, reflecting our increased visibility into the business as we approach year end. We are reiterating our product bookings guidance range, which continues to reflect our current assessment of the range of potential outcomes for full year 2026.
